title: The Backyard Shed Where Momofuku Ando Started Again at 48
conflicts: Ando's role in the failed credit union: director (Nissin), managing director (AFP), head at a friend's request (Nippon.com), 'presided over' (Economist); the story uses the company's 'served as a director'. The Economist dates the noodle-queue inspiration to 1957, Nissin and Nippon.com to the postwar years; the story follows the latter without a precise date. First-year sales (13 million bags) appear only in the Economist and are attributed to it.
notes: Stance 'challenges': Plato's Republic VII (youth is the time for extraordinary toil) set against Ando learning a new craft at 48. Nippon.com mentions earlier arrests (found innocent); left out as outside the episode. Slate said 'lost everything': sources say he kept a rented house in Ikeda, and the story says 'almost everything'.
